requirements.description: Monthly stock returns from CRSP, sample period 1929-1987 (cross-sectional regressions Table I) and 1934-1987 (predictive portfolios Table II-VI)
Daily stock returns from CRSP, sample period 1963-1987 (Panel II of Table VI bid-ask-spread correction, requires excluding the last trading day of month t-1)
Exchange codes (hexcd) and share codes (shrcd) for stock filtering and PIT joins
CRSP equal-weighted index used as market proxy in the market model (eq. 3) and as the 1929-1982 sample-period market in Table I
1-month Treasury bill rate used as risk-free rate in the market model (eq. 3); paper says source is CRSP but FF rf is identical and available from 1926

NYSE size quintile portfolio returns for the size-based 3-factor model in Table V (R_St, R_Mt, R_Lt). CRSP provides NYSE-only equal-weighted decile returns; we form 5 quintiles from the relevant decile groups
Stock-level monthly assignment to size deciles for the size-quintile subsample regression in Table I (Q1, Q3, Q5)
